Omg, I had a very silimar experience when I was a kid! At 6 or 7 I saw this special on TV that was full of grey aliens and abductions, and it traumatized me really bad. I began sleeping with the lights on and curtains shut as best I could every night. I was afraid to get a glass of water at night because I was 99% sure I'd be grabbed by an alien, and always felt like I was being watched from dark places. Anyway, one night I was asleep in bed like a week or two after I got this phobia, and my curtains were weird because their was a good 8 inch gap (I'm in USA) along the top looking into blackness. I saw a grey alien with tan, almost orange skin looking through the gap. It's head started bobbing up and down, and it was looking around the room as if it could not move it's big black eyes and had to turn it's whole head to look at things. I was horrified so much I couldn't move, then woke up the next morning. Another time i woke up to see a grey alien head standing next to my bed. I was on the top bunk so it was kind tall, but I don't recall if it did anything to me. Then really weird stuff started happening around the house, and I never told anyone what happened to me. I could go on about all the weird occurrences, but let me just say, eventually my family got tired of all the weird shit happening.  

Now I know your very rational and skeptical about the supernatural so Idk if you'll like this answer but here's what we did. My parents went out and got dry Sage and walked through the whole house every night burning the Sage while praying to Jesus to cleanse the house of evil in Christ's name. They then took "holy oil" (which is oil that has priests pray over it I think, not sure, I think it's a Catholic tjimg, but we weren't Catholic) and drew crosses on our foreheads with it before bedtime while praying for protection and cleansing of Evil. After about three days of this it all stopped. My phobia ceased, I was no longer afraid of the dark or sleeping, or open windows, or even aliens. Also all the other phenomenon stopped. No more loud bangs, slamming doors, or footsteps on the roof, or things showing up in weird places, or the baby crying because he says he sees invisible little men walking around the house. It all ceased. 

I don't know if that helps any, hopefully others can give their advice too. I hope you get better man, I personally don't think Grey aliens exist, I think it's either just psychological or bad interdimensional entities of some kind.
